{{Color box|{{party color|Stand Up Quezon}}|border=darkgray}} [[Stand Up Quezon|Stan Q]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Quezon's 4th congressional district''' is one of the four [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Quezon]], formerly '''Tayabas'''. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |access-date=October 7, 2020}} The district consists of municipalities in the [[Tayabas Isthmus]] and [[Alabat Island]], namely [[Alabat, Quezon|Alabat]], [[Atimonan]], [[Calauag]], [[Guinayangan]], [[Gumaca]], [[Lopez, Quezon|Lopez]], [[Perez, Quezon|Perez]], [[Plaridel, Quezon|Plaridel]], [[Quezon, Quezon|Quezon]] and [[Tagkawayan]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Mike Tan (politician)|Keith Micah Tan]] of the [[Nationalist People's Coalition]] (NPC) and [[Stand Up Quezon]] (Stan Q).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |access-date=October 7, 2020}} ==Election results from provincial races== {| class=wikitable |- !
